def solve(case):
    payload = case['payload']
    nodes = payload['nodes']
    required_symbols = payload['required_symbols']
    node_dict = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    # build children mapping
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(n['id'])
    # initially all ids retained
    retained = set(n['id'] for n in nodes)
    # sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending (lexicographic? id is string, but we can use string comparison for stable tie)
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    removal_order = []
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        if not n['removable']:
            continue
        if n['parent'] is None:  # root
            continue
        if n['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # check if node has any retained children
        has_retained_children = any(cid in retained for cid in children.get(nid, []))
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        # tentative removal: remove node from retained, check required symbols
        retained.remove(nid)
        # check if all required symbols still present
        all_present = all(
            any(node_dict[cid]['symbol'] == sym for cid in retained)
            for sym in required_symbols
        )
        if all_present:
            removal_order.append(nid)
            # node already removed from retained
        else:
            # revert removal
            retained.add(nid)
    # after loop, retained set has final retained ids
    retained_ids = sorted(retained)  # sort as strings? Use natural order, id is string
    return {'retained_ids': retained_ids, 'removal_order': removal_order}
